generation_supplier.notes: No official El Monte city page or Clean Power Alliance page confirming or naming El Monte as a CPA member community was found this session. Left null rather than guessed in either direction.

county.notes: El Monte is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes El Monte/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Three required contacts: applicant, contractor, and property owner
General solar details and system specifications

value: Contact the Building Division at (626) 580-2050 (Monday-Thursday, 7:00am-5:30pm) with the permit number and address ready
Four-hour inspection time slots are assigned for the first available date

value.notes: The City's own SolarAPP+ page explicitly describes 'an online application for an auto-issued permit' and details a same-session process (submit, wait about 30 seconds for the system to create the permit record, then pay online to receive permit issuance) for SolarAPP+-eligible projects.

other_conditions: Main dwelling rooftop, permitted, residential structures only — no ballasted or ground-mounted systems eligible
Only licensed contractors may submit applications

eligibility_constraints.notes: No specific kW size cap is stated on the page for El Monte.

permit_fees.notes: The page states 'a processing fee will be charged by SolarApp+ NREL' covering up to three revisions, but no dollar amount is given.
